verdict.rationale: Grok Bot clearly operates applications on a computer. It works on a persistent cloud computer with a browser, filesystem, and terminal, and the Agent Computer preview shows its clicks, typing, and navigation. Computer actions are gated by approvals and Auto Review, and users report the per-bot computer working well. On the user's own machine, though, the evidence only shows 'Execution on Local Computer' for running commands (per-command approval by default) and routing egress through the desktop, not seeing and operating local GUI applications. missing for 10: documented see-and-control of applications on the user's own desktop (not just shell commands), independent hands-on corroboration of local-machine operation.
